outcome.technical: (1) READER, plugins/audit/scripts/status/_skill_places.py skill_digest: a depth-first walk of sorted os.scandir listings; every entry met (file, directory, link) counts toward MAX_SKILL_ENTRIES (renamed from MAX_SKILL_FILES, since it now counts every entry) as it is listed; each name is checked first (_name_problem: not UTF-8, or a line break -> unreadable naming it); each entry is os.lstat'ed; a directory is pushed; anything else goes to _file_target: a regular file is itself, a link must stay inside and lead to a regular file, and a FIFO, socket, character or block device, dangling link, link out, link to a directory or link to a non-regular file is unreadable by name and kind and never opened; the file's size is compared with what is left of MAX_SKILL_BYTES BEFORE the open; _read_file opens O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW(|O_BINARY), fstat must be the same regular file (else 'changed while it was read'), reads 64 KiB chunks, stops past the remaining budget, and hashes as it reads. (2) LINE ENDINGS: NORMALISED_SUFFIXES = ('.md',), compared without case, defined beside the digest with its cost (a checkout converting a non-Markdown file's line endings changes the digest; remedy: mark the skill directory not-text for git); CRLF is folded chunk-safely (a CR ending a chunk is carried). No case argued against '.md' alone. (3) A PIN IS ABOUT A DIRECTORY: covering_pins matches a handed name to every pin spelled the same or resolving to the same directory by os.path.samestat; pin_verdicts/pin_stops/pin_flags/require_pins all ask it; pin_directory_problems reports two pins on one directory with different digests, and require_pins refuses every hand-out over it; _manifest_rules: a warning rules.meta.skill-pin-unused (unused_pins, judged by bare name, lowercased, since validation reads no file; a plan with no pins walks nothing) and skill_pin_findings(manifest, tree, user_home, plugin_root) for the directory clash. validate-manifest.py does NOT call skill_pin_findings: that file is outside this task's files; the hand-out refusal holds meanwhile.
